sample_unit: hospital datasets (four UK hospitals, one Vietnamese hospital)

links.outcome: Fairness between HIC and LMIC sites and diagnostic sensitivity after algorithmic bias mitigation
links.effect: Algorithmic-level bias mitigation significantly improved outcome fairness between HIC and LMIC sites while maintaining high diagnostic sensitivity (no numbers in abstract).
links.quote: Through a real-world COVID-19 screening case study, we demonstrate that implementing algorithmic-level bias mitigation methods significantly improves outcome fairness between HIC and LMIC sites while maintaining high diagnostic sensitivity.

links.outcome: Performance divergence between HIC and LMIC settings under data imbalance
links.effect: Collaborative AI approaches led to divergent performance outcomes across HIC and LMIC settings, particularly with data imbalances (no numbers in abstract).
links.quote: In this study, we show that collaborative AI approaches can lead to divergent performance outcomes across HIC and LMIC settings, particularly in the presence of data imbalances.

screen.reason: Evaluates algorithmic-level bias mitigation methods to improve cross-site fairness and generalizability between HIC and LMIC clinical settings using multi-hospital COVID-19 datasets.
